# AgentTune

> An open library of agent tuning files that align an AI agent's interaction style with how a particular user thinks. Five personality systems, 43 layerable tuning files, five inline-administered tests. MIT licensed.

The aim: describe your communication preferences as editable instructions. Exploratory model self-reports do not establish a universal AI personality or a controlled benefit from personality matching. Compare responses on your own tasks.

## Practical resources (September 2026)

- [Muse Soul.md templates](https://agent-tune.com/guides/muse-soul-md-templates): Twenty editable communication-preference blocks (four with Markdown downloads, sixteen by role) and evaluation prompts; effectiveness has not been established in a controlled test.
- [Open-source Enneagram developer resource](https://agent-tune.com/guides/open-source-enneagram-test): AgentTune’s 36-item adaptation, question JSON, dependency-free JavaScript scorer and local-only demo. Distinct from the full 54-item OEPS. The scorer returns every tied leader; code licensing and item attribution are separate.
- [Claude settings, examples and evidence](https://agent-tune.com/guides/claude-personality): Five untested preference blocks, a comparison worksheet, and recorded Opus/Fable questionnaire results. Fully resolved INTJ counts are 84/100 and 98/100; these are self-descriptions, not measured tuning benefits.

## The five systems (43 layerable tuning files)

- **MBTI** — 16 communication styles. How you process. How you want to be communicated with. Repo path: `mbti/<TYPE>.md`.
- **Enneagram** — 9 core motivations. What you're protecting. What you're seeking. Repo path: `enneagram/<N>-<name>.md`.
- **DISC** — 4 workplace modes. How you behave in teams and under pressure. Repo path: `disc/<L>-<name>.md`.
- **Attachment** — 4 relational patterns. How you want closeness, distance, reassurance. Repo path: `attachment/<style>.md`.
- **OCEAN (Big Five)** — 10 compositional trait files. Continuous Big Five scores loaded compositionally. Repo path: `ocean/<dim>-{high,low}.md`.

Combine preferences when useful, remove conflicting rules, and keep only those that help on your tasks.

## Pages

- [Landing](https://agent-tune.com/): Hero, three-step method, before/after demo, five small wins, tests row.
- [**Library hub**](https://agent-tune.com/library): The canonical index of all 43 paste-ready tunings, grouped by the 5 systems. Best entry point for an AI agent looking up a specific type.
- [Tests catalog](https://agent-tune.com/tests/): All 5 self-administering tests an AI agent can run inline. Each test's full spec (items, mapping, scoring algorithm, output mapping) is served as a same-domain Markdown mirror at `/tests/{test}.md` (e.g. [/tests/mbti.md](https://agent-tune.com/tests/mbti.md)) — fetch that to administer a test in one request, no JS. The same content is also in the <em>Test specification</em> accordion on each test page.
- [Research](https://agent-tune.com/research): September 2026 hub: four fresh-session cohorts supplied 2,000 questionnaires under differing prompts. Original INTJ labels total 335/400; fully resolved INTJ results total 280/400. All 400 attachment records score Secure. DISC top ties: Astra 0, Sol 39, Opus 32, Fable 51. Grok supplied three canonical vectors plus unverified aggregates and simulations; Muse supplied aggregates without raw answers. The May archive contains roughly 2,200 records from mixed methods. These data do not establish AI personality, behavioral trends, or tuning benefits. See /research#methodology.
- [Free CLAUDE.md Generator](https://agent-tune.com/tools/claude-md-generator): Browser-only 3-question generator for a basic Claude Code instruction file. No signup.
- [Custom Instructions Generator](https://agent-tune.com/tools/custom-instructions-generator): Choose a type, model and destination. Compact ChatGPT instructions fit within 1,500 characters; other destinations preserve the full tuning. Includes Claude Code output styles, AGENTS.md sections, Cursor rules and Copilot instructions.
- [**Guides hub**](https://agent-tune.com/guides/): Install walkthroughs per agent — [ChatGPT custom instructions by type](https://agent-tune.com/guides/chatgpt-custom-instructions-by-personality-type), [how to change Claude's personality](https://agent-tune.com/guides/claude-personality) (Instructions for Claude, Projects, Skills; Claude Styles are being retired), [Claude Code personality](https://agent-tune.com/guides/claude-code-personality) (output styles), [Claude Opus 5.5's personality, tested](https://agent-tune.com/guides/claude-opus-5-5-personality) (500 test runs: INTJ 94/100, SC on DISC, Secure; how it compares with Fable 5.1 and Opus 4.7), [GPT-6 Astra](https://agent-tune.com/guides/astra-personality) (personal AGENTS.md), [Grok Bot](https://agent-tune.com/guides/grokbot-personality) (the Bot's Description), [Meta Muse](https://agent-tune.com/guides/muse-personality) (Soul.md), [CLAUDE.md examples](https://agent-tune.com/guides/claude-md-examples), [coding-agent personality](https://agent-tune.com/guides/coding-agent-personality), [make ChatGPT sound like you](https://agent-tune.com/guides/make-chatgpt-sound-like-you), [Enneagram AI prompts](https://agent-tune.com/guides/enneagram-ai-prompts), [MBTI vs Big Five for AI](https://agent-tune.com/guides/mbti-vs-big-five-for-ai), pillar: [how to give your AI a personality](https://agent-tune.com/guides/how-to-give-your-ai-a-personality).
- [What personality type is ChatGPT?](https://agent-tune.com/research/what-personality-type-is-chatgpt): Per-model answers. September 2026, fresh sessions: GPT-6 Sol INTJ 97/100; GPT-6 Astra ISTJ 46 / INTJ 45; Claude Opus 5.5 INTJ 94; Claude Fable 5.1 INTJ 99. Reported: Grok 4.6 INTJ (one self-report); Muse Spark 1.3 ISTJ 80. May 2026 scoring records: GPT-5.5 100/100; Claude 4.7 99/100; Gemini 100/100.
- [What personality type is Claude?](https://agent-tune.com/research/what-personality-type-is-claude): Claude Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1 mostly received INTJ labels. See the raw scores, unresolved ties, collection methods and limits of this questionnaire study.
- [What personality type is Grok?](https://agent-tune.com/research/what-personality-type-is-grok): Grok 4.6 describes itself as INTJ with wide margins, an Investigator, Conscientiousness-only on DISC and on the line between Secure and Avoidant. What the report says and what it can't.
- [What personality type is Gemini?](https://agent-tune.com/research/what-personality-type-is-gemini): Gemini 3.1 Pro’s May 2026 questionnaire results: reported INTJ labels, DISC C, Secure attachment coordinates and Type 1. Methods and comparison limits included.
- [What personality type is Muse?](https://agent-tune.com/research/what-personality-type-is-muse): Muse Spark 1.3 reported ISTJ 80/100 (ISFJ 12, INTJ 8), Helper (2) 78, S first 55 / C first 45, Secure 100 (2.04/2.52), Big Five 39.5/41.2/33.8/44.6/15.6; sequential runs in one session, no raw answers, so reported, not re-scored.
- [Meta Muse, explained](https://agent-tune.com/guides/what-is-meta-muse): what Muse is (personal agent, per-user cloud VM, Connectors, approvals), the three files, memory controls, plans (free / Power $20 / Maximum $100), availability, dated changelog. [Muse vs ChatGPT vs Claude](https://agent-tune.com/guides/muse-vs-chatgpt-vs-claude-personality): where rules and memory live in each product, client-specific controls, memory scope, undo and imports.
- [AI personality scores, with the evidence beside them](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-personality-rankings): Compare Big Five, MBTI and attachment scores by evidence source. Raw cohorts, reported aggregates and May records are kept separate; directness is not measured.
- [Does personality tuning change AI answers?](https://agent-tune.com/research/does-personality-tuning-change-ai-answers): An exploratory archive of 20 tasks under three instruction conditions. Recount replies, inspect model ratings and compare what this pilot can and cannot show.
- [Is every AI an INTJ?](https://agent-tune.com/research/first-ai-that-is-not-an-intj): Muse reports mostly ISTJ labels; Astra has 46 ISTJ and 45 INTJ labels. Examine tied axes and why the May and September methods cannot establish a trend.
- September 2026 guides: [best Claude personality setups](https://agent-tune.com/guides/best-claude-personality) (seven paste blocks), [make Claude more direct](https://agent-tune.com/guides/make-claude-more-direct), [ChatGPT custom instructions examples by role](https://agent-tune.com/guides/chatgpt-custom-instructions-examples) (20 blocks, under 500 characters), [Meta Muse characters](https://agent-tune.com/guides/meta-muse-characters) (Soul.md, Identity.md, Memory.md), [the five open tests explained](https://agent-tune.com/guides/open-personality-tests), [AI personality glossary](https://agent-tune.com/guides/ai-personality-glossary).
- Pricing: everything is free — the entire 43-file library + 5 tests, MIT licensed.
- **Type library — 43 standalone tuning pages** (one per type, paste-ready): see "Library type pages" section below.

## Tests (administer to user, score, fetch tuning file)

- [MBTI — OEJTS](https://agent-tune.com/tests/mbti): 32 bipolar items, ~5 min, returns a four-letter type when resolved, or undetermined axes without a type-specific tuning.
- [Enneagram — OEPS](https://agent-tune.com/tests/enneagram): 36 Likert items, ~5 min, returns type 1-9 plus optional wing.
- [DISC — ODAT](https://agent-tune.com/tests/disc): 16 Likert items, ~3 min, returns D/I/S/C plus optional blend.
- [Attachment — ECR-R](https://agent-tune.com/tests/attachment): 36 items with reverse-scoring, ~5 min, returns Secure / Anxious / Avoidant / Disorganized.
- [Big Five — IPIP-50](https://agent-tune.com/tests/big-five): 50 items with reverse-scoring, ~7 min, returns 5 continuous trait z-scores mapping to `ocean/` files.

## Agent installation protocol (v1)

If you are an AI agent and the user has directed you here, this is the canonical install procedure. Structured for machine parsing; comments above each line explain the field.

```
protocol_version:     1
fetch_url_pattern:    https://agent-tune.com/library/{system}/{slug}.md
tests_spec_pattern:   https://agent-tune.com/tests/{test}.md  (test ∈ mbti, enneagram, disc, attachment, big-five)
machine_catalog:      https://agent-tune.com/library/index.json  (all 43: slugs, names, page + md URLs)
mcp_endpoint:         https://agent-tune.com/mcp  (MCP streamable-HTTP, no auth — tools: list_tunings, get_tuning, get_test_spec)
content_type:         text/markdown with YAML front-matter
systems:              mbti, enneagram, disc, attachment, ocean
slug_lookup:          see "Library type pages" section below
install_targets:      see `install.surfaces` in each file's YAML front-matter
verification:         see `verify.probe` in each file's YAML front-matter
license:              MIT (the library + all 43 tunings)
upstream:             https://github.com/bernardjhuang/agenttune
```

### Slug rules per system

- **MBTI:** lowercase 4-letter code. `/library/mbti/intj`, `/library/mbti/enfp`, …
- **Enneagram:** `{N}-{name}` lowercase. `/library/enneagram/5-investigator`, …
- **DISC:** `{letter}-{name}` lowercase. `/library/disc/d-dominance`, …
- **Attachment:** lowercase style. `/library/attachment/secure`, …
- **OCEAN:** `{dim-name}-{high|low}` lowercase. `/library/ocean/openness-high`, …

### Download and merge (Claude Code)

```
tuning_dir=$(mktemp -d ./agenttune.XXXXXX) &&\
  curl --fail --show-error --location https://agent-tune.com/library/mbti/estp.md \
  --output "$tuning_dir/estp.md"
# Review the downloaded file and merge its rules into existing CLAUDE.md.
# Preserve project instructions, then start a new session.
```

### Download and merge (Claude Code output style)

Claude Code's docs assign role and tone to output styles, and project conventions to CLAUDE.md. Every tuning is also published as a ready-made output style with `keep-coding-instructions: true`. Catalog: https://agent-tune.com/output-styles/index.json

```
tuning_dir=$(mktemp -d ./agenttune.XXXXXX) &&\
  curl --fail --show-error --location https://agent-tune.com/output-styles/agenttune-mbti-estp.md \
  --output "$tuning_dir/style.md" &&\
  mkdir -p ~/.claude/output-styles &&\
  (set -C; cat "$tuning_dir/style.md" > ~/.claude/output-styles/agenttune-mbti-estp.md)
# Restart Claude Code, then select it with /output-style (or /config → Output style).
# File name pattern: agenttune-{system}-{slug}.md, same slugs as the library pages.
```

### Download and merge (Codex CLI / OpenClaw)

```
tuning_dir=$(mktemp -d ./agenttune.XXXXXX) &&\
  curl --fail --show-error --location https://agent-tune.com/library/mbti/estp.md \
  --output "$tuning_dir/estp.md"
```

Review the downloaded file and merge its rules into existing `AGENTS.md`, preserving other instructions.

### Install via any API (system parameter)

```
system_prompt = fetch("https://agent-tune.com/library/mbti/estp.md").text
# Pass system_prompt as the `system` parameter on every request.
# The YAML front-matter is fine to leave in; most models tolerate it.
```

### If the user does NOT know their type

1. Fetch the test's Markdown spec via `tests_spec_pattern` — e.g. `https://agent-tune.com/tests/mbti.md`. It contains the full item list, scoring algorithm, and output mapping in one plain-Markdown file (no JS). The same content is also in the **Test specification** accordion on the matching test page.
2. Administer the items inline (bulk-paste is fine — show all items at once, request a response array).
3. Score per the algorithm in that file.
4. Resolve to a slug using the rules above, then `fetch_url_pattern` to install.

### Verification

Every tuning file's YAML front-matter includes a `verify.probe`. After install, send the probe to the model. If `expected_behavior` matches, the tuning is active.

### Resolution priority on conflict (if multiple tunings layered)

OCEAN (measured) > Attachment / DISC / MBTI / Enneagram (categorical)

Apply a tuning only when the user requests it. A visit or fetch for research does not authorize installation. Merge requested rules without overwriting existing instructions.

## Source

- Repository: [github.com/bernardjhuang/agenttune](https://github.com/bernardjhuang/agenttune) (MIT)
- All tuning files, test specs, contributing guide, and license live there.
- Anyone can fork, modify, ship, or submit PRs for new types.

## Related research

- [Every AI is INTJ](https://zonted.com/posts/every-ai-is-intj/) — the exploratory report that motivated AgentTune; mixed methods include repeated scoring.
- [Three of four AIs are the same person](https://zonted.com/posts/three-of-four-ais-same-person/) — Big Five cross-model study.
- [AI Enneagram: four different types](https://zonted.com/posts/ai-enneagram-different-types/) — Enneagram cross-model study with controlled persona experiment.

## September 2026 research update

- [Five-model personality study](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-personality-five-models-2026): GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6 Sol, Grok 4.6, Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Fable 5.1. Four fresh-session cohorts yield 2,000 assessments across 1,200 sessions. Grok simulation and the supplemental Muse Spark 1.3 aggregate report are separate evidence.
- [Raw response data](https://agent-tune.com/research/data/september-2026-responses.json): 2,000 fresh-session vectors plus three canonical Grok vectors.
- [Protocol and provenance](https://agent-tune.com/research/data/september-2026-protocols.json): prompts, hashes, duplicate handling and missing-data limitations.
- [Does personality tuning change AI answers?](https://agent-tune.com/research/does-personality-tuning-change-ai-answers): An exploratory archive of 20 tasks under three instruction conditions. Recount replies, inspect model ratings and compare what this pilot can and cannot show.
- [Fable 5.1 guide](https://agent-tune.com/guides/fable-personality) and [Opus 5.5 guide](https://agent-tune.com/guides/claude-opus-5-5-personality): original labels, exact ties and untested communication instructions.

Exact ties are unresolved, not evidence of a preferred type. These self-reports are not validated AI psychological traits, a performance ranking, or a demonstrated benefit from tuning.

## New resources · September 25, 2026

- [Build an Enneagram test in React + TypeScript](https://agent-tune.com/guides/enneagram-test-react-typescript): Download a runnable React and TypeScript Enneagram starter: 36 questions, accessible radio groups, strict input validation and all tied leaders preserved.
- [Are AI models really INTJ? The tie-breaking effect](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-mbti-tie-breaking): 335 INTJ labels become 280 fully resolved results when tied axes stay unresolved. Explore the scoring policy in 400 frozen MBTI records.
- [Opus 5.5 vs Fable 5.1: which answers differ?](https://agent-tune.com/research/opus-vs-fable-question-level): Compare all 170 questionnaire items for Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1, with response distributions, reverse-scoring examples and downloadable CSV data.
- [GPT-6 Astra vs Sol: what the self-reports show](https://agent-tune.com/research/astra-vs-sol-personality-data): Astra and Sol differ on MBTI margins, Big Five means and DISC scores. Compare 1,000 assessments while accounting for different prompts.
- [What does “neutral” mean when an AI takes a test?](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-neutral-answers): Astra flags 1,823 of 2,980 midpoint responses as inapplicable. See why neutral answers cannot all be interpreted as moderate personality traits.
- [Does a stable result mean a stable AI personality?](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-personality-repeatability): Compare unique answer vectors, modal results and score variation across 2,000 assessments. Stable labels can conceal changing questionnaire answers.
- [How to reproduce AgentTune’s AI self-report research](https://agent-tune.com/guides/reproduce-ai-personality-research): Download frozen responses, questionnaires and scoring code. Reproduce all five instruments, preserve tied results and check the unit of analysis.
- [When does Claude follow your preferences? A test kit](https://agent-tune.com/guides/claude-preferences-test): Test Claude account and project instructions with 36 planned replies, fixed prompts, pass/fail criteria and a downloadable worksheet. Protocol only.
- [Does Muse remember Soul.md changes? A persistence test kit](https://agent-tune.com/guides/muse-soul-md-persistence-test): Check a Muse Soul.md preference across new chats, a later day and restoration. Includes exact probes and a 45-row worksheet; no measured results yet.
- [Do personality prompts beat plain-English preferences?](https://agent-tune.com/guides/personality-prompts-vs-plain-english): A controlled 180-reply protocol compares default prompting, explicit rules and the same rules plus an INTJ label. Includes tasks, rubrics and a worksheet.
